rows.TEXT:
Forest Elf 
"Know this, Human. Your trickery will not go unpunished. You thought to use our trust to trap and murder our messiah? You've only created a martyr and my people will scream his name as we tear down your precious Empire!"

Emry of Abrissel 
"What madness was that? We've not heard from the Elves until now and we're not to meet with Lachla'an for days!"

Advisor 
"I think it is safe to assume the Elf messiah has been slain. Why you are being blamed for his demise is what puzzles me. We can only assume the Elves have been tricked."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Damn Crowley!  How did this twisted man ever come to power? We can only wait for further contact from the Elves, but until then, we will continue to march upon his castle! The people of this region have suffered enough!"

Emry of Abrissel 
"Come out of the shadows. I know you're here."

Imperial Assassin 
"I have news which may interest you. Milady's spy service has uncovered something that you should know. We may be...discreet...but we remain honorable."

Imperial Assassin 
"No doubt you are aware of the Elf prophet's demise. We were not able to observe the murder, but we witnessed the aftermath. Count Crowley's men, wearing your insignia, paraded about the cities boasting their victory over the Elves."

Emry of Abrissel 
"The leprous dog! So I assume I have Lady Ambrielle's support in marching upon Crowley's forces?"

Imperial Assassin 
"Assume nothing. Milady will take the throne, and you still stand in her way. We merely offer information. Use it as you will. You will see me again."

Imperial Assassin 
"I bring more news, Baron."

Emry of Abrissel 
"GAH! Don't sneak up on a man during his dinner! You know I would allow you entrance through the gates like any other guest."

Imperial Assassin 
"I prefer to avoid the public eye. I bring you information from Lady Ambrielle, use it how you will. Crowley's inquisition is corrupt to its core."

Emry of Abrissel 
"You travel this far to tell me something so obvious?"

Imperial Assassin 
"You misunderstand. Bethrezen receives Crowley's prayers. He speaks to the demons as if they were angels, and what better way to sate the bloodlust of demons than to snatch away innocents in the name of an Inquisition?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"Your accusations are extreme. How do I know the Duchess isn't trying to eliminate her competition by feeding me false information?"

Imperial Assassin 
"The people of this land who suffer under Crowley's self-righteous rule are her people as well. We are simply moving pieces into place. You will witness the truth as you near Crowley's stronghold."

Eighttoe 
"Humans? You've got a lot of courage to venture this close to Clans territory. Still, gold is gold to Ole' Eighttoe. Hurry, buy what you need before the patrols see you!"

Okknor 
"It's true! These lands are scorched by demon flame! Melasem lies ahead...the stronghold of Crowley and his unholy Inquisition."

Count Flamel Crowley 
"What's this? Knights upon my doorstep? They look like filthy sinners, do they not?"

Eldae 
"They do have the stench about them. Guilty indeed! On with the trials!"

Count Flamel Crowley 
"No...the Highfather...will not allow this. My angel, why do you allow my death? Do I not complete your every command?"

Eldae 
"Yes, Crowley. You've been a most useful puppet to us."

Flamel Count of Crowley 
"Puppet? Wait...you're no angel! How could I have..."

Eldae 
"Hahahahaha. We've got a grand welcome waiting for you, Count. Bethrezen will be pleased to finally meet you."

Dark Elf Lachla'an 
"Ahhh...the Humans. How insignificant you are. You're nothing more than a tiny tremble in the passing of eternity. I don't have the time to waste on you."

Okknor 
"Milord, the armies of Verzillin are amassing. The small forces we have left behind will not be able to withstand an assault should they choose to march upon our kingdom."

Emry of Abrissel 
"What is the Duchess planning? No information exceeds the reach of her spies. Surely she knows we fight a great evil in the name of the Empire!"

Natell 
"The people of these lands are no longer faithful to the Empire - They have been torn back and forth in the tide of our war with Crowley. Perhaps it seems like cruelty to assault them yet again, but it would be crueler to let Crowley take them."

Peasants 
"Suffering is all we've ever known. Please, do not whip us! We will obey."

Zera 
"Do not fear us. Sir Emry of Abrissel is not a cruel master. He will repair your city and make sure you have food for your family. All we ask is that you help us to bring down Count Crowley."

Peasant 
"We will do what we can."

Defender of Faith 
"Halt! This side of the river belongs to Count Crowley and his faithful! Should you heretics attempt to pass, we shall smite you with all the power of the Highfather!"

Zera 
"It is good fortune that we have recaptured Flittersby. Long ago, the great wall around this city was erected to hold off the Demon armies. Crowley was trying to bring it down!"

Zera 
"Crowley's forces grow stronger each day! Where are they getting their power?"

Zera 
"A section of the wall is missing! This is the work of demons, no doubt. You can still smell the presence of their dark arts!"

Paladin 
"Thank the Highfather! You have liberated us! Crowley is a madman! For no apparent reason, he jailed the entire garrison!"

Paladin 
"We were all awaiting our trials, but we were never accused of anything. I hate to think of what might have happened without your intervention."

Natell 
"This old Dwarven city has nothing in it. From what we can tell, the Clans have been fighting over it for some time. The constant state of war has left little gold  in the city's coffers."

Zera 
"Such a waste of life...we only wish to speak with the Dwarves, yet they attack us unprovoked."

Dresdon 
"No doubt Crowley has been torturing their people in his witch trials. They must hate us."

Dresdon 
"Finally we have control over the peasants. This city will make a fine addition to our Empire. It offers much needed resources and its position is strategically ideal. Well done, Milord."

Dresdon 
"Spare us your disgusting whimpering, creatures! We would rather you keep your forked tongues behind your teeth!"

Ranger 
"The old council ground has become a den. It is strange to see bears this close to civilization. Their hides will decorate our halls and warm our beds."

Garrison 
"Leave us alone! We don't want any part of your war! We are free!"

Dresdon 
"Orcs. It doesn't matter what part of the world you are in, you will always find Orcs in some dank corner."

Dresdon 
"Why wouldn't the Clans attempt to fell this fearsome beast? Fortunate for us , I suppose."

Dresdon 
"So, Mortis' corpse armies have reached these lands as well.  We've stopped them here, let us pray it is enough."

Zera 
"This temple used to be a place of peace and meditation! How could Crowley allow the mutilation of such a precious monument to the Highfather's people?"

Natell 
"The Dragons, at one time, were under the control of the Elves. When Gallean was lost, the alliance that held them together slowly started to disintegrate. It is plain to see now that they are wild, and that we should be wary."

Natell 
"And now the great Tower of Scroan has fallen into darkness. The Tiara of Purity, one of the most beautiful artifacts of the realm, stored here for safekeeping, is gone. The Empire is losing so much to this damned war."
One day, when we win the war, my name will be written in history. I have supplies for your men.
Get the supplies you need today, for we may have moved on should you seek us tomorrow.
Do you have anything interesting to sell me?
Come in and have a look, I have many potions for many situations.
To capture dragonite and hold it in your palm- that is what I can offer you!
Do you really think your simple minds can grasp these concepts? Fine, we shall see...
By the time they've completed my tests, your men will be ready to face any foe.
You have the gold we agreed on? Bring them in, I will train them.
Don't expect any gold back from me if you get them killed.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, she is known for her intensity in battle and her courage in the face of overwhelming odds. She once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
